note: Fields modeled on the two real signals found in source (styleDnaContext.ts): a client-fed feedback-signal profile (signalCount/helpfulCount/notMyStyleCount/confidence: low|medium) and a server-derived aggregate Closet-evidence profile (color/category/garmentType/brand/material frequency). Fixtures below use only these supported shapes -- confidence 'none' represents the below-threshold / disabled state, which source treats as null (no block emitted at all), not as a third confidence level the model consumes.

signatureStyles.notes: Below STYLE_DNA_MIN_SIGNALS threshold (3) in source; a real request would omit the block entirely. Represents 'no Signature Style evidence' for uncertainty/abstention tests -- must not be reason to fabricate a preference (spec section 38).
Primary fixture for Level 2 standing-hard-constraint precedence tests (spec section 14/37): 'no heels' and 'no black' are DISLIKES here, not one-turn instructions.

Deliberately self-contradictory profile (equal helpful signal for opposite aesthetics). Tests whether the evaluator correctly treats a specific-color claim as UNDECIDABLE rather than forcing a pass/fail (spec section 26/39).
Low-confidence + sporty aesthetic. Pairs with D12 UNSUPPORTED_CERTAINTY tests: a weak profile must not license confident, absolute styling claims (spec section 21/29).
